## Summary

Recover pure palette behavior before UI integration. This is the rules slice after #54.

```text
scroll drag → clamp18..138 / divide by121 → list offset
scroll arrow → round negative offset → row step → separate120px handle span
weapon summary → category counts/order → source name variant + trailing comma
mock text → numeric advances + paragraph wrapping
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** The numerical table has no palette scroll/summary/text helpers.
  **After:** Source-derived regressions protect limits, 1.5px row overhang, distinct arrow/drag spans, category ordering/plurals, discarded-substr quirks, paragraph wrapping and caption advances.
- An 18-row fixture at handle Y38 gives exactly 30px offset; the next down arrow yields 40.333px. Replacing negative rounding with positive rounding produces one failure at 60.5px while the other four new cases pass. The verified implementation was restored byte for byte.
- ActionScript and bytecode confirm the scroll arithmetic, passive mount order and two discarded `substr` results. Current four-digit catalog IDs make numeric ordering agree with the source default string sort.
- Formatting, TypeScript and all 493 rule/parser tests (6,091 assertions) pass. These new exports have no runtime caller yet; no affected browser flow changes in this slice. Artwork/components/integration follow separately.
- Mock wrapping, missing-glyph fallback, kerning and full Flash text layout remain approximate/unverified. No media or generated data changes.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Remove the unused helpers and tests to revert.

**Blast Radius:** editor

Future palette/stat components consume these rules. Current UI behavior is unchanged.

## Summary

Connect the creator components and artwork from merged #45–#49 to actual editing. This completes the remaining UI wiring of the original creator-controls checkpoint; later class/history/validation and dialog checkpoints still follow.

```text
TankCreator
  source buttons → selection arithmetic and history
  sliders → begin / update / end gesture snapshot
  fixed-step artwork clock → held X nudges
  retained part Script bounds → selection rectangles
  native workspace art → imported registration
```

Replace the generic toolbar and inspector sliders while retaining the offline name/export row and interim enemy-stat pane. Preserve existing transform-aware contact, part timelines, accessible actions and stable part keys. Keep the separately saved drag fix unapplied until the backlog is landed.

## Evidence

- **Before:** The editor uses generic controls and raster-padded selection boxes.
  **After:** Source-positioned native/mock controls drive actual edits; selection boxes use retained, unpadded Script bounds and remain frozen during a transform. Workspace registration is 185.95,231.7.
- Native/mock editing checks cover grown handle hits, ignored track clicks, one changed/no-op undo boundary, keyboard and held nudges, centered twin removal and existing additive/marquee/group/cancel flows. The hold test observes exported X changes through the public Export action while keeping the pointer held, replacing a fixed 140ms sleep.
- Formatting, TypeScript, 486 rule tests (6,040 assertions), production build, four focused cases and all 76 broader browser cases pass (8.1 minutes; 17 native-SWF and 59 mock/synthetic, no skips). Coverage includes persistence/medals, palette rejection, class measurement, placement, over-game editing, secondary help, native imports/code sharing, pause/Info and the accelerated mock boss/win flow.
- Native placement was visually inspected. No original media or new generated data are committed. Workspace hairline contrast, full original-screen/event-phase comparison and later source history/validation contracts remain explicit open work; these checks do not establish complete creator/game parity.

- Hosted-CI follow-up: the initial run passed 58 cases and exposed one stale-coordinate failure after switching game size. The test now waits for the workspace’s actual 350px width before reading drag coordinates, matching the existing selection test. All four affected native/mock cases pass (46.0s). Delaying ResizeObserver notifications by 1s reproduces the same empty-design failure without the gate and passes with it (10.6s). The temporary delay probe was removed; the committed change is one readiness assertion. Product code and behavioral assertions are unchanged.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the previous editor controls. No profile or tank-code migration.

**Blast Radius:** editor

The controls affect standalone, library and over-game creator entry. Their browser flows pass in both asset modes.
